explanation: atlas.ts is now the single reader of the HypoMap export: named gene records, WHOLE/NO_REGION/EXPRESSION_UNIT/COHORT, pooled and per-dataset metrics, datasetSummary (mean, SEM), spatialTable/datasetTable/atlasTable, findAtlasGene, missMessage, one cached load per symbol, and a swappable transport with a cache reset. HypoMapPreview and Coexpression read those instead of the wire and share one wording for a missing or ambiguous gene; CsvDialog downloads through the export-provenance seam; codetection.ts only imports WHOLE.
